requirement.title: AI Recruitment Automation Platform — Atomic Requirements
requirement.author: DuyMT
requirement.summary: Decomposition of all upstream requirements into 91 atomic REQ-* statements across 5 categories: Functional (45), Non-Functional (14), Data (14), Integration (8), Constraint (10). Each requirement includes priority, rationale, acceptance criteria, and source traceability.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall search candidates across multiple external channels (job boards, LinkedIn, internal databases).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: System supports ≥3 channel connectors; search query returns results from each within 30s.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall match candidates to job descriptions using semantic search (embedding similarity).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Cosine similarity computed for each candidate-job pair; results ranked by score.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall rank candidates using weighted scoring (skills 40%, experience 30%, education 20%, organizational preference 10%).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Composite score computed and displayed per candidate; weight values are admin-configurable.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall send automated outreach messages to top-ranked candidates.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Message dispatched within 5 min of match; recruiter can review before send.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall parse resume files in PDF and DOCX formats.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Parsing succeeds for ≥95% of valid PDF/DOCX files; structured fields extracted.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall extract structured fields from parsed CVs: full name, email, phone, location, skills, work experience, education.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Each field extracted with ≥90% accuracy on test corpus.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall screen parsed CVs against job requirements using weighted scoring and vector similarity.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Screening score generated within 15 seconds; score includes explainable breakdown.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall score and rank candidates with explainable rationale per score factor.
functionalRequirements.rationale: Trust and transparency for recruiter decisions.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Each score component shows contributing factors (e.g., 'Skills match: 8/10').

functionalRequirements.text: System shall detect duplicate candidates across all client pools.
functionalRequirements.rationale: Prevents duplicate applications in multi-client environment.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate detected when similarity > 90% on name + email + phone combination.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall integrate with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook for availability sync.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Calendar events readable/writeable; sync latency <60s.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall collect candidate availability via portal or email link.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Candidate submits ≥1 preferred slot; data stored and available for matching.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall collect interviewer availability from connected calendars.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Interviewer availability windows read automatically from calendar.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall suggest top 3 optimal interview slots based on overlapping availability.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Suggestions generated within 5 seconds; respects business hours and timezones.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support multi-round scheduling (phone screen → technical → onsite).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Each round type configurable; sequential and parallel round flows supported.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall send automated reminders to participants 24 hours before scheduled interviews.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Reminder sent via email and in-app notification 24h before interview.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support rescheduling via self-service links in notifications.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Candidate/interviewer can reschedule from link without recruiter intervention.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall handle timezone-aware scheduling for JP (JST), VN (ICT), and EN (US/EU) timezones.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: All times stored in UTC; displayed in participant-local timezone; auto-detect from location/IP.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support configurable MCQ assessments (single and multiple correct answers).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: MCQ rendered and graded correctly; supports ≥10 questions per assessment.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support predefined answer scoring (exact match, regex).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Scoring engine matches answers with 100% accuracy for predefined patterns.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall evaluate assessments instantly and return scores within 5 seconds.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Score returned ≤5s after submission.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall allow recruiters to configure pass/fail thresholds per job.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Threshold configurable from 0–100 per job; default 60.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall generate AI-driven score breakdowns with strengths and weaknesses.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Breakdown generated within 15s; includes per-question or per-skill analysis.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall allow recruiters to override auto-pass/fail decisions.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Override recorded with reason; audit trail maintained.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall provide a visual kanban board for candidate pipeline stages.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Board renders all candidates by stage; drag-and-drop supported.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support configurable pipeline stages per client (default: Applied → Screening → Interview → Technical → Offer → Hired/Rejected).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add, rename, reorder stages; defaults applied on client creation.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall trigger automatic stage transitions based on configurable rules (pass/fail/timeout).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Auto-transition fires within 60s of trigger event (e.g., assessment pass).

functionalRequirements.text: System shall display a real-time dashboard with candidate counts and pipeline metrics per stage.
functionalRequirements.rationale: At-a-glance visibility for recruiters and clients.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard updates within 10s of stage changes; shows counts, conversion rates.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall translate CVs/resumes between JP, VN, and EN using LLM-based translation.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Translation delivered within 30 seconds; covers full document.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall translate interview feedback between JP, VN, and EN.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Feedback translated preserving context; delivered within 15s.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall translate job descriptions between JP, VN, and EN.
functionalRequirements.rationale: Content localization for multi-market job postings.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: JD translated within 30s; industry terminology preserved.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall auto-detect source language of input content.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Language detected with ≥95% confidence before translation.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall route low-confidence translations (<80%) to a human review queue.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Items with confidence <80% flagged; visible in reviewer queue.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall send automated email notifications to candidates (application received, interview scheduled, stage updates, rejection/offer).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Email sent within 60s of trigger event; delivered to valid addresses.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall send automated notifications to recruiters (new application, AI match ready, scheduling conflicts).
functionalRequirements.rationale: Keeps recruiters informed in real time.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: In-app notification within 30s; email within 60s.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall send pipeline progress reports to HiringCompanies.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Configurable frequency (daily/weekly); email delivery.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support email templates with agency branding customization.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Templates editable per agency; HTML + plain text formats.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall authenticate users via email and password (bcrypt hashing).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Login flow succeeds for valid credentials; rejects invalid.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support optional SSO via Google and Microsoft accounts.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: OAuth2 flow completes; user mapped to agency account.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall support optional multi-factor authentication.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: MFA setup and verification flow works; bypassable for non-admin roles.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall enforce role-based access control at entity level (not just route level).
functionalRequirements.rationale: Data isolation between roles and clients.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Each API call validated against RBAC matrix; unauthorized access rejected with 403.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall manage user sessions via JWT access/refresh tokens.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Token issued on login; refresh before expiry; logout invalidates.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall scope jobs, candidates, and applications to their owning HiringCompany (client).
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Queries filtered by client_id; cross-client data access denied.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall allow a recruiter to manage multiple HiringCompanies.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Recruiter can switch active client context; each client's data isolated.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall provide a shared candidate pool with deduplication across all clients within an agency.
functionalRequirements.rationale: Avoids duplicate outreach to same candidate.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Deduplication runs on candidate creation; matches on email + phone + name similarity.

functionalRequirements.text: System shall allow each HiringCompany to configure their own pipeline stages and workflows.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Stage customization per client; default template available.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Dashboard page load shall complete in <2 seconds.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: P95 response time <2s measured by browser DevTools.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: CV parsing + AI scoring shall complete in <15 seconds per candidate.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end latency measured and reported; 95th percentile <15s.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: AI candidate matching score shall compute in <15 seconds per candidate-job pair.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Latency measured from request to ranked results; P95 <15s.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Interview slot suggestions shall generate in <5 seconds.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Suggestions returned ≤5s after availability data submitted.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Translation shall complete in <30 seconds per document.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Document translated and returned ≤30s for up to 10-page CVs.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: System shall support 500+ concurrent users across all tenants.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Load test passes with 500 concurrent sessions; no degradation beyond +200ms latency.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Architecture shall be multi-tenant with data isolation per agency.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Tenants cannot access each other's data; verified via penetration test.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: AI processing workloads shall scale horizontally via message queue.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Queue absorbs 10x normal load without data loss; auto-scaling triggered.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Static assets shall be served via CDN.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Assets served from edge nodes; cache hit ratio >90%.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Database read replicas shall serve analytics queries.
nonFunctionalRequirements.rationale: Prevent reporting from impacting transactional performance.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Analytics queries routed to replicas; production DB unaffected.
Monthly uptime calculated; reported in status dashboard.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Automated backups shall maintain ≤24-hour Recovery Point Objective.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Backup verified daily; restore test passes quarterly.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: System shall fall back to rule-based processing when LLM services are unavailable.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: When LLM API fails, system detects within 10s and activates rule-based fallback; user notified.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Health check endpoints shall be available for all critical services.
nonFunctionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: /health endpoints return 200 for DB, AI API, queue, cache; integrated with alerting.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store Agency entity with fields: id, name, logo_url, settings, subscription_tier, created_at.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Agency record created on registration; all fields persisted.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store Recruiter entity with fields: id, name, email, role (admin/recruiter/interviewer), agency_id.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Recruiter assigned to agency; role enforced in RBAC.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store HiringCompany entity with fields: id, name, industry, contact_info, agency_id.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: HiringCompany linked to agency; data isolated per client.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store Job entity with fields: id, title, description, requirements, salary_range, client_id, status, stages_config.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Job created under HiringCompany; stages_config stores custom pipeline config.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store Candidate entity with fields: id, full_name, email, phone, location, resume_url, languages.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Fields persisted after CV parse or manual entry; searchable.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store Application entity with fields: id, candidate_id, job_id, status, stage, applied_at, ai_match_score.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Created on application submission; stage updated on transitions.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store Interview entity with fields: id, application_id, type (phone/technical/onsite), scheduled_at, interviewer_id, status, recording_url.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Created on scheduling; recording_url populated post-interview.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store Assessment entity with fields: id, application_id, type (mcq/predefined_answer), score, breakdown, ai_feedback.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Created on assessment completion; score and breakdown persisted within 5s.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store LocalizedContent entity with fields: id, source_lang, target_lang, source_text, translated_text, entity_type, status, confidence, version.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Stores each translation request; supports re-translation via version history.

dataRequirements.text: System shall store AIMatch entity with fields: id, application_id, embedding_vector, matching_score, skill_scores, org_preference_score, explanation.
dataRequirements.rationale: AI match record for audit and explainability.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Created after each matching run; vector stored for re-ranking if needed.

dataRequirements.text: Agency shall have one-to-many relationships with Recruiters, HiringCompanies, Candidates, and Jobs.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key constraints enforced at database level.

dataRequirements.text: Recruiter shall have many-to-many relationship with HiringCompanies (managed_by).
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Join table created; recruiter can be assigned to multiple clients.

dataRequirements.text: Application shall belong to exactly one Candidate and one Job.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Constraint enforced; an application cannot exist without both.

dataRequirements.text: Interview, Assessment, LocalizedContent, and AIMatch shall reference their parent Application.
dataRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: All child records have valid application_id FK.

integrationRequirements.text: System shall integrate with SendGrid or AWS SES for email delivery.
integrationRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Emails sent reliably; delivery tracked via provider API.

integrationRequirements.text: System shall integrate with Google Calendar API for availability and scheduling.
System shall integrate with Microsoft Outlook Calendar API for availability and scheduling.
System shall integrate with OpenAI API (GPT-4o, text-embedding-3-large) as primary AI provider.
integrationRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: API key configured; requests succeed with <500ms latency per call.

integrationRequirements.text: System shall integrate with Google Gemini API as fallback AI provider.
integrationRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: When OpenAI fails, requests automatically routed to Gemini within 10s.

integrationRequirements.text: System shall support future integration with external ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday).
integrationRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: API contract defined; not implemented in MVP.

integrationRequirements.text: System shall support pgvector or Pinecone for vector similarity search.
integrationRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Embeddings stored; similarity query returns results in <1s for 10K vectors.

integrationRequirements.text: System shall integrate with ClamAV or equivalent for malware scanning of uploaded files.
integrationRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: All uploaded CVs scanned before storage; infected files rejected.

constraintRequirements.text: All user inputs shall be sanitized against XSS, SQL injection, and NoSQL injection.
constraintRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Penetration test shows no injection vulnerabilities.

constraintRequirements.text: All candidate PII shall be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).
System shall enforce file upload validation: only PDF and DOCX, max 25MB, magic bytes verification.
constraintRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Non-PDF/DOCX files rejected; oversized files rejected; magic bytes verified.

constraintRequirements.text: API requests shall be rate-limited to 100 req/min per user; uploads to 10 files/min per user.
constraintRequirements.rationale: Prevent abuse and ensure fair usage.
constraintRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Rate limit enforced; 429 response returned when exceeded.

constraintRequirements.text: System shall comply with GDPR and CCPA requirements (right to erasure, data portability, consent management).
constraintRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Erasure request deletes all PII; export provides all user data in standard format.

constraintRequirements.text: System shall maintain configurable data retention policy per agency (6, 12, or 24 months).
constraintRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Admin sets retention period; automatic purge runs on schedule.

constraintRequirements.text: All candidate data access events shall be logged with who, what, when, IP, and device fingerprint.
constraintRequirements.rationale: Audit trail for compliance and security.
constraintRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Logs immutable; queryable via admin audit panel.

constraintRequirements.text: System shall deploy on GCP (Cloud Run or GKE).
System shall use OpenAI as primary and Gemini as fallback AI provider.
MVP budget shall target $500–1,500/month for AI API usage and infrastructure.
constraintRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Monthly cost dashboard tracks actual spend; alerts at 80% threshold.

crossCategoryTraceability.description: Maps non-functional/data/integration/constraint requirements back to upstream features

newOpenQuestions.question: Should translation support batch processing (multiple CVs at once) or only one at a time?
newOpenQuestions.impact: Affects queue design and UX flow; batch processing more efficient but increases complexity

newOpenQuestions.question: Should candidate outreach messages be fully AI-generated or template-based with AI personalization?
newOpenQuestions.impact: Affects content generation scope; fully AI offers more personalization but requires more guardrails

newOpenQuestions.question: Should candidate deduplication be automatic (merge) or flag-only for recruiter review?
newOpenQuestions.impact: Affects data model and UX; automatic merge is more efficient but risks data loss

checks: All RAW-* sources from Phase 1 have ≥1 downstream REQ-*
All new requirements (translation, email, RBAC, multi-client) have REQ-* coverage
Non-functional requirements decomposed into measurable atomic statements
Integration requirements mapped to specific providers
Security and compliance requirements explicitly stated
Every REQ-* has measurable acceptance criteria
Every REQ-* has source traceability (no orphan requirements)
Priority assigned consistently (P0 = MVP, P1 = next, P2 = future)
No technical design decisions leak into requirement level
